title: English Practice Quiz 0298
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The keys are ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On describes something resting on a surface.

questions.question: We have a meeting ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: Use on with days and dates.

questions.question: A polite way to disagree is:
options: I see your point, but I have a different view.
questions.explanation: This phrase acknowledges the other person before presenting a different view.

questions.question: They said, 'We have finished.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect commonly shifts to past perfect in reported speech.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use do + subject + base verb for present simple questions with you.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I like tea, coffee and milk.
I like tea coffee and milk
I like, tea coffee, and milk.
i like tea, coffee and milk
questions.explanation: Use commas to separate items in a list and capitalise the first word.

questions.question: She arrived ___.
questions.explanation: Late is the correct adverb meaning not on time.

questions.question: A person you can trust is ___.
Which word has a different beginning sound?
questions.explanation: This begins with the voiced /ð/ sound; the others begin with the unvoiced /θ/ sound.
